deduplication_interpretation: The two repository snapshots preserve the same archived scientific source/data observations. These copies must not count as independent replication evidence. Distinct runtime entries within the archives remain distinct where the actual metadata/results support this.
limits: Separate Git roots prove neither which storage first created the files nor a physical copy direction.
Earlier import time and newer repository name do not authorize declaring an actively maintained canonical repository.

No archived run receipt supplies an explicit actual runtime Git commit in the inspected top-level run metadata. All observed execution timestamps precede both Git repository initial commits; repository commit hashes identify archive snapshots, not proved executed checkouts.
Release descriptions state submission packaging intent; they do not establish journal acceptance, independent replication or a new experiment.
Historical figure scripts were inspected and preserved; this history audit does not rerun their numerical analysis or QPU experiments.
